name: Rock House
positioning: Cliffside resort with Amalfi-inspired design on a 14-acre oceanfront site on the north coast of Providenciales
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet cliffside setting away from the densely touristed areas
Snorkelers who want to swim straight from the shore onto the barrier reef

facts.text: Rock House is on the north coast of Providenciales on a 14-acre oceanfront site.
It is in a residential neighborhood called Blue Mountain, away from the densely touristed areas.
Rock House is less than 10 minutes from the airport.
Local craftsmen chiseled the natural limestone into the resort's walls and walkways.
The idea for Rock House traces back to the cliffside Hotel du Cap-Eden-Roc in Antibes, where Melissa, the future wife of Grace Bay Resorts co-founder Mark Durliat, conducted celebrity interviews.
The private beach sits at the base of a limestone cliff, with a jetty reaching into the protected waters of the North Shore.
Snorkeling gear, see-through paddle boards and kayaks are complimentary.
Suites, duplexes and studios have their own terraces with ocean views and 13-foot vaulted ceilings.
Vita restaurant is perched over 30 feet above the sea.
Cave Bar has natural rock walls and serves handcrafted cocktails.
The Spa at Rock House uses marine botanicals from OSEA and nail care from Manucurist Paris.
Once a week, a complimentary evening of gentle yoga, sound bath and stargazing is offered.

highlights.text: Rock House is nestled into a limestone cliff with elevations up to 95 feet above sea level.
The resort has an Amalfi-inspired design.
Rock House received a 2026 MICHELIN Key.
The beachfront lies along the third-largest barrier reef in the world, so guests can snorkel right from the shore.
Vita serves traditional Italian dishes with Caribbean influence.

considerations.text: There are no special activities for young children.
There are currently no ADA standards for accessible design in place.
The spa has two double treatment rooms.
